Full sweep

Why this happens

Eckart–Young makes the truncated SVD provably optimal for a given rank in Frobenius norm. Any other model can only beat it by expressing something off the rank-k manifold — and the Hadamard product of two rank-r matrices genuinely does reach rank up to r². The expressiveness is real in principle.

It just isn't converted into approximation quality. That is now the second sighting of the same failure: extending to k>2 factors, the predicted rⁿ rank was equally unreachable, and k=2 beat every deeper product at matched accuracy.

There is also a data dependence worth noting. On the MRI — large black regions, hard edges — HadNet wins clearly at matched rank. On the natural image it is a wash or slightly worse, meaning twice the parameters buys nothing at all.

Correction: this does not generalise

An earlier version of this page concluded that the paper's advantage was a parameter-budget artifact in general. That was wrong. It was measured on these two images only, and images are the regime where SVD is strongest.

Re-run on full-rank random data — the setting of the paper's headline Tables 2, 5 and 6 — the result inverts. HadNet wins the matched-storage comparison at 6 of 7 ranks, and at rank 40 it is numerically exact (0.000000) where SVD with the same storage still carries 8% error.

The spectrum decides it. Natural and medical images are approximately low-rank: their singular values decay fast, so a truncated SVD is already near-optimal and the extra expressiveness has nothing left to capture. Full-rank data has a flat spectrum where truncation is genuinely costly and the r² reach pays.

So what these pictures show is real, but its scope is narrow: the paper's image and video applications are its weakest case, not its strongest — the reverse of the impression Table 9 gives.

Before this hardens

  • Two images, both 256×256. No video reconstructions were saved — only images. And as the correction above shows, the image result does not transfer to full-rank data.
  • HadNet may be under-trained. 2000 epochs with LR decay is the paper's own budget, but “the optimiser cannot reach the good solutions” and “the solutions are not there” are different claims. This does not separate them.
  • Parameter count is not the only compression metric. SVD's singular values are ordered and quantise well; Hadamard factors carry no such structure. A codec-level comparison could shift the picture.
